meta.title: Ye Poora Channel AI Se Banta Hai

scenes.headline: *100% AI* CHANNEL
scenes.subtitle: Main bas decide karta hoon, dikhata hoon kaise.
scenes.voice: Ye poora channel AI se banta hai. Main bas decide karta hoon. Dikhata hoon kaise.

scenes.headline: STEP 1: *CLAUDE SCRIPT*
scenes.voice: Step 1: script. Main Claude Code ko topic deta hoon. Wo research karta hai, sources check karta hai, aur script likhta hai. Main approve karta hoon.

scenes.headline: STEP 2: *OPENAI VOICE*
scenes.label: AI Transcription Verified
scenes.voice: Step 2: awaaz. Ye awaaz OpenAI ke voice model ki hai. Har reel ke teen se paanch takes bante hain, aur AI transcription se check hota hai ki koi word galat toh nahi.

scenes.headline: STEP 3: *WHISPER CAPTIONS*
scenes.cardText: Whisper har ek word ka exact millisecond time nikaalta hai, isliye bubble ke words bilkul awaaz ke saath chalte hain.
scenes.voice: Step 3: captions. Whisper har word ka time nikaalta hai. Isliye bubble ke words bilkul awaaz ke saath chalte hain.

scenes.headline: STEP 4: *AVATAR IS CODE*
scenes.voice: Step 4: avatar. Ye avatar, ye drawing nahi, code hai. Aur mera muh awaaz ki loudness se hilta hai.

scenes.headline: STEP 5: *REMOTION ENGINE*
lines: // Har card, har sticker, code hai!
const pop = spring({ frame, config: { damping: 14 } });
scenes.voice: Step 5: animation. Remotion naam ka tool React code se video banata hai. Har card, har sticker, code hai.

scenes.headline: PARALLEL *AI AGENTS*
scenes.voice: Aur sabse mazedaar: Claude Code alag AI agents bhejta hai, jo parallel mein kaam karte hain. Script approve hone ke baad reel lagbhag 15 minute mein ready.

scenes.headline: WANT THIS *PIPELINE*?
scenes.cardText: Comment 'pipeline' to get the full source code, prompts, and architecture breakdown in upcoming reels!
scenes.voice: Ye pipeline chahiye? Comment karo “pipeline”. Poora breakdown agle reels mein.

scenes.headline: SHARE WITH *A FRIEND*
scenes.voice: Ye reel us dost ko bhejo jo sochta hai reels banana bahut mehnat ka kaam hai.
